AI system is not generating any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, which suggests it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows zero active trades and zero profit/loss, which is unusual given the presence of active strategies.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize the CPU usage to prevent potential slowdowns or outages.
Review and potentially enhance AI algorithms to ensure they are generating learning cycles and identifying trading opportunities.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the active trading strategies to ensure they are being executed properly.
